say.en: As-salāmu ‘alaykum wa rahmatullāh (may the peace and mercy of Allah be upon you)

scene.ar: تدخل غرفة الاستراحة في عملك، وفيها مجموعة من زملائك المسلمين جالسون يتحدثون. لم تعتد بعدُ على التحية التي يتبادلونها، وتحب أن تبدأ بها أنت.
scene.en: You walk into the break room at work, where a group of Muslim colleagues are sitting and talking. You are not used to the greeting they exchange yet, and you would like to be the one who starts it.

keyPoints.en: the passer-by should greet the one who is sitting

h5352.ar: لِيُسَلِّمِ الصغيرُ على الكبيرِ، والمارُّ على القاعدِ
h5352.en: The young should greet the old, the passer-by should greet the one who is sitting

q4-86.ar: وَإِذَا حُيِّيتُم بِتَحِيَّةٖ فَحَيُّواْ بِأَحۡسَنَ مِنۡهَآ أَوۡ رُدُّوهَآۗ
q4-86.en: And when you are greeted with a greeting, greet [in return] with one better than it or [at least] return it

say.en: 'Allahumma iftah li abwāba rahmatik' (O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy)
'Allahumma inni as’aluka min fadlik' (O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty)

scene.ar: تصل إلى المسجد قبل صلاة العصر بدقائق. عند الباب رجل كبير يرحّب بالمصلين، ويلاحظ أنك تتمهّل قليلًا قبل أن تدخل.
scene.en: You reach the mosque a few minutes before the 'Asr prayer. An older man at the door is welcoming people, and he notices you pause for a moment before going in.

character.en: Abu Khalid, who prays at this mosque

keyPoints.en: 'Allahumma iftah li abwāba rahmatik' (O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy)

h65092.en: 'Allahumma iftah li abwāba rahmatik' (O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy)

say.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلاَةِ القَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الوَسِيلَةَ وَالفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
say.en: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the prayer that is to be established, grant Muhammad Al-Wasīlah and Al-Fadīlah and resurrect him to the Praiseworthy Station that You have promised him

scene.ar: أنت في بيت صديقك حين يُرفع أذان المغرب من المسجد القريب. يخفض صديقك صوت التلفاز ويصمت.
scene.en: You are at a friend's home when the call to prayer for Maghrib rises from the nearby mosque. Your friend turns the television down and falls quiet.

keyPoints.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلاَةِ القَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الوَسِيلَةَ وَالفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
keyPoints.en: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the prayer that is to be established, grant Muhammad Al-Wasīlah and Al-Fadīlah and resurrect him to the Praiseworthy Station that You have promised him

h10635.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلاَةِ القَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الوَسِيلَةَ وَالفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
h10635.en: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the prayer that is to be established, grant Muhammad Al-Wasīlah and Al-Fadīlah and resurrect him to the Praiseworthy Station that You have promised him

h65087.en: and then invoke Allah's blessings upon me

say.ar: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ
say.en: Alhamdulillah al-ladhi at‘amani hadha wa razaqneih min ghayri hawl li wala quwwah (Praise be to Allah who fed me and provided me with this food through no might or power on my part)

scene.ar: تجلس مع زميلة لك على غداء العمل. هي مسلمة منذ صغرها، وأنت تتعلم أن للطعام آدابًا لم تعرفها من قبل.
scene.en: You sit down to a work lunch with a colleague who has been Muslim all her life. You are learning that eating has manners you did not know before.

keyPoints.en: let him eat with his right hand

h5431.ar: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ
h5431.en: Alhamdulillah al-ladhi at‘amani hadha wa razaqneih min ghayri hawl li wala quwwah (Praise be to Allah who fed me and provided me with this food through no might or power on my part)

b-eating.ar: والأكل باليمين والشرب بها، والتسمية عند الابتداء، والحمد عند الفراغ
b-eating.en: eating and drinking with the right hand, saying Bismillāh (in the Name of Allah) at the beginning, and Alhamdulillāh (praise be to Allah) upon finishing

h58122.ar: إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِيَمِينِهِ، وَإِذَا شَرِبَ فَلْيَشْرَبْ بِيَمِينِهِ
h58122.en: If anyone of you eats, let him eat with his right hand, and if he drinks, let him drink with his right hand

say.en: he should say 'alhamdu-lillāh' (praise be to Allah)
'yarhamuk Allah' (may Allah have mercy on you)
'yahdīkum Allah wa yuslih bālakum!' (may Allah guide you and grant you well being)

scene.ar: في اجتماع صباحي يعطس زميلك المسلم ويقول شيئًا بصوت منخفض. وبعد قليل تعطس أنت أيضًا.
scene.en: In a morning meeting, your Muslim colleague sneezes and says something quietly. A little later, you sneeze too.

keyPoints.en: 'yarhamuk Allah' (may Allah have mercy on you)
'yahdīkum Allah wa yuslih bālakum!' (may Allah guide you and grant you well being)

h3433.en: he should say 'alhamdu-lillāh' (praise be to Allah)

b-sneezing.en: responding to the sneezer if they praise Allah

say.ar: فَذَكَرَ اللهَ عِنْدَ دُخُولِهِ وَعِنْدَ طَعَامِهِ
say.en: When one mentions Allah's name upon entering his house and upon eating

scene.ar: تعود إلى البيت بعد يوم طويل، ومعك أخوك الصغير الذي يسألك عن كل ما تفعله منذ أسلمت.
scene.en: You come home after a long day with your younger brother, who asks about everything you have done since you became Muslim.

keyPoints.en: When one mentions Allah's name upon entering his house

h3037.ar: فَذَكَرَ اللهَ عِنْدَ دُخُولِهِ وَعِنْدَ طَعَامِهِ
h3037.en: When one mentions Allah's name upon entering his house and upon eating

say.ar: سَمِّ اللهَ، وَكُلْ بِيَمِينِكَ، وَكُلْ مِمَّا يَلِيكَ
say.en: mention Allah's name, eat with your right hand, and eat from what is nearer to you

title.en: When you are invited to a meal

scene.ar: يدعوك جارك المسلم إلى وليمة عرس أخيه نهاية الأسبوع. تتردد قليلًا لأنك لا تعرف أحدًا هناك.
scene.en: Your Muslim neighbour invites you to his brother's wedding meal at the weekend. You hesitate a little, because you will not know anyone there.

h58120.ar: سَمِّ اللهَ، وَكُلْ بِيَمِينِكَ، وَكُلْ مِمَّا يَلِيكَ
h58120.en: mention Allah's name, eat with your right hand, and eat from what is nearer to you

h58112.ar: إذا دُعِيَ أحدكم إلى الوَلِيمَة فَلْيَأْتِهَا
h58112.en: If one of you is invited to a wedding banquet, he should attend

say.ar: لا بأس؛ طَهُور إن شاء الله
say.en: No harm, (it will be) purification (from sins) if Allah wills

scene.ar: زميلك في المسجد في المستشفى منذ أيام. تذهب لزيارته وتحمل له بعض الفاكهة، ولا تعرف ماذا تقول حين تدخل.
scene.en: A friend from the mosque has been in hospital for a few days. You go to visit him with some fruit, not sure what to say when you walk in.

keyPoints.ar: لا بأس؛ طَهُور إن شاء الله
keyPoints.en: No harm, (it will be) purification (from sins) if Allah wills

h6009.ar: لا بأس؛ طَهُور إن شاء الله
h6009.en: No harm, (it will be) purification (from sins) if Allah wills

say.en: Indeed we belong to Allāh, and indeed to Him we will return

say.ar: إنَّ لِلَّه ما أَخَذ ولَهُ ما أَعطَى، وكلُّ شَيءٍ عِنده بِأجَل مُسمَّى فَلتَصبِر ولتَحتَسِب
say.en: To Allah belongs what He takes, and to Him belongs what He gives, and for everything He sets a specific term. So she should have patience and seek the reward from Allah

scene.ar: توفي والد زميلك في العمل. تذهب مع الزملاء إلى بيت العائلة، وتجد زميلك عند الباب يستقبل المعزّين.
scene.en: A colleague's father has passed away. You go with others from work to the family home, and find your colleague at the door receiving people.

keyPoints.ar: إنَّ لِلَّه ما أَخَذ ولَهُ ما أَعطَى، وكلُّ شَيءٍ عِنده بِأجَل مُسمَّى فَلتَصبِر ولتَحتَسِب
keyPoints.en: To Allah belongs what He takes, and to Him belongs what He gives, and for everything He sets a specific term. So she should have patience and seek the reward from Allah

q2-156.en: Indeed we belong to Allāh, and indeed to Him we will return

h3290.ar: إنَّ لِلَّه ما أَخَذ ولَهُ ما أَعطَى، وكلُّ شَيءٍ عِنده بِأجَل مُسمَّى فَلتَصبِر ولتَحتَسِب
h3290.en: To Allah belongs what He takes, and to Him belongs what He gives, and for everything He sets a specific term. So she should have patience and seek the reward from Allah

b-condolence.en: offering condolences in times of affliction

say.ar: الْإِسْلَامُ أَنْ تَشْهَدَ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللهِ، وَتُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةَ، وَتُؤْتِيَ الزَّكَاةَ، وَتَصُومَ رَمَضَانَ، وَتَحُجَّ الْبَيْتَ إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ إِلَيْهِ سَبِيلًا
say.en: Islam is to testify that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, to establish prayer, to pay Zakah, to fast Ramadan, and to perform Hajj to the House if you are able to find a way thereto

title.en: When a colleague asks about Islam

scene.ar: زميلتك في العمل ليست مسلمة، ولاحظت أنك تغيّرت في الأسابيع الماضية. تسألك بفضول ولطف عن دينك الجديد.
scene.en: A colleague who is not Muslim has noticed a change in you over the past weeks. She asks, kindly and curiously, about your new faith.

keyPoints.ar: الْإِسْلَامُ أَنْ تَشْهَدَ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللهِ، وَتُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةَ، وَتُؤْتِيَ الزَّكَاةَ، وَتَصُومَ رَمَضَانَ، وَتَحُجَّ الْبَيْتَ إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ إِلَيْهِ سَبِيلًا
keyPoints.en: Islam is to testify that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, to establish prayer, to pay Zakah, to fast Ramadan, and to perform Hajj to the House if you are able to find a way thereto

h4563.ar: الْإِسْلَامُ أَنْ تَشْهَدَ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللهِ، وَتُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةَ، وَتُؤْتِيَ الزَّكَاةَ، وَتَصُومَ رَمَضَانَ، وَتَحُجَّ الْبَيْتَ إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ إِلَيْهِ سَبِيلًا
h4563.en: Islam is to testify that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, to establish prayer, to pay Zakah, to fast Ramadan, and to perform Hajj to the House if you are able to find a way thereto

h3390.ar: فَادْعُهُمْ إِلَى أَنْ يَشْهَدُوا أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللهِ
h3390.en: invite them to testify that none is worthy of worship except Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah

say.ar: إذا قُلْتَ لِصَاحِبِكَ: أَنْصِتْ، يومَ الجمعةِ، والْإِمامُ يَخْطُبُ، فَقَدْ لَغَوْتَ
say.en: If you say to your companion 'listen' on Friday while the Imām is delivering the sermon, you have thus engaged in idle talk

scene.ar: اليوم أول جمعة لك. يتصل بك صديقك صباحًا ليتفق معك على الذهاب، وتصلان إلى المسجد والإمام قد بدأ الخطبة.
scene.en: Today is your first Friday. A friend calls in the morning to go together, and you reach the mosque just after the imam has begun the sermon.

keyPoints.en: Whoever of you comes to attend the Friday prayer, let him take a shower
listens to it attentively and keeps silent

h3107.ar: إذا قُلْتَ لِصَاحِبِكَ: أَنْصِتْ، يومَ الجمعةِ، والْإِمامُ يَخْطُبُ، فَقَدْ لَغَوْتَ
h3107.en: If you say to your companion 'listen' on Friday while the Imām is delivering the sermon, you have thus engaged in idle talk

h5433.ar: فَاسْتَمَعَ وَأَنْصَتَ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَزِيَادَةُ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ
h5433.en: listens to it attentively and keeps silent, his sins between that Friday and the following Friday will be forgiven, with the addition of three more days

h5394.en: Whoever of you comes to attend the Friday prayer, let him take a shower

h5205.en: Get up and pray two Rak‘ahs

say.ar:
صــوم رمضــان هــو: التعبُّــد لله 
تعالــى بالإِمســاك عــن الطعــام 
والشــراب والجمــاع
say.en: Fasting Ramadan means worshiping Allah by abstaining from eating, drinking, and sexual intercourse

scene.ar: هذا أول رمضان لك. تتصل بك صديقة أسلمت قبلك بعامين لتطمئن عليك في الليلة الأولى.
scene.en: This is your first Ramadan. A friend who became Muslim two years before you calls on the first evening to see how you are.

keyPoints.en: Have Sahūr (pre-dawn meal) for, indeed, there is a blessing in Sahūr

keyPoints.ar:
مــن طلــوع الفجــر 
إلــى غــروبِ الشــمسِ

b-fasting.ar:
صــوم رمضــان هــو: التعبُّــد لله 
تعالــى بالإِمســاك عــن الطعــام 
والشــراب والجمــاع
b-fasting.en: Fasting Ramadan means worshiping Allah by abstaining from eating, drinking, and sexual intercourse

h4498.en: Have Sahūr (pre-dawn meal) for, indeed, there is a blessing in Sahūr

h4525.ar: مَنْ نَسِيَ وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ، فَأَكَلَ أَوْ شَرِبَ، فَلْيُتِمَّ صَوْمَهُ
h4525.en: Whoever forgets while fasting and eats or drinks, let him complete his fast
